notes: England, Wales and Northern Ireland. Scotland has its own income tax bands, not included yet. Savings and dividend income have their own allowances and rates; here other income is taxed at the normal rates. The High Income Child Benefit Charge, the marriage allowance and Gift Aid aren't included.

regimes.name: England, Wales and Northern Ireland
regimes.description: Income tax on earnings and other income, with Class 1 National Insurance on salary.

deductions.label: Pension contributions taken before tax
deductions.hint: Through your employer's net pay or salary sacrifice scheme. Contributions you make yourself get relief at source instead and aren't entered here.

deductions.label: Work expenses you can claim
deductions.hint: Uniform, tools, professional fees and other costs of your job that your employer didn't pay back.

levies.name: National Insurance (Class 1)
levies.note: Worked out on the year's salary; employers work it out each pay period, so the total can differ slightly.
